Class TotpGenerator

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.security.totp.TotpGenerator
@Component public class TotpGenerator extends Object
Time-based one-time passwords after RFC 6238 with the parameters every authenticator app supports: HMAC-SHA1, six digits, a step of 30 seconds and a secret of 20 random bytes, shown Base32-encoded without padding. A code is accepted for the current step and the one before and after it, which covers clocks that are off by up to half a minute and a code typed shortly before its step ended.

The time comes from an InstantSource, so tests compute codes for an explicit instant.
